description: This Java source file defines the WeibullDistribution class, which implements the Weibull probability distribution, including methods for density, cumulative probability, inverse cumulative probability, and statistical moments, within the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: WeibullDistribution
classes.description: Implementation of the Weibull distribution with methods for density, distribution, and statistical moments, extending AbstractRealDistribution.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Computes the probability density function at a given point x.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Computes the natural logarithm of the density at x.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative probability up to x.

methods.name: inverseCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the quantile (inverse of the CDF) for probability p.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution, calculated via the gamma function.

methods.name: calculateNumericalMean
methods.description: Private helper to compute the mean based on distribution parameters.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution, computed via gamma functions.

methods.name: calculateNumericalVariance
methods.description: Private helper to compute the variance based on distribution parameters.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution's support, always 0.

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the distribution's support, always positive infinity.

methods.name: isSupportLowerBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates that the lower support bound is inclusive (true).

methods.name: isSupportUpperBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates that the upper support bound is not inclusive (false).

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates that the support of the distribution is connected (true).
